caveat: These periods were inspected in previous experiments. This is retrospective development evidence; a new prospective cohort is required.
dataFence: Only observations with date strictly before target date minus one calendar day. Target-match statistics, odds and future scores never enter inputs.
selectionRule: Minimum validation log loss among challengers whose top-outcome accuracy is at least the current candidate on the identical v1-eligible cohort. Persist the choice before evaluating audit seasons. If none qualifies, retain the current candidate.
xgNotSelected: HxG/AxG currently cover only the 90 current-season matches in this archive; not used to select or claim an xG improvement.
